cards.title: Distinguish breakouts from speculation
cards.question: Which research approaches fit a bull market versus a bear market?
cards.selfCheck: A bull market can reward momentum but also inflate weak stories. In a bear market, research fundamentals and neglected opportunities while checking financial resilience.
cards.prompt: Explain my bull-market versus bear-market research methods with risks and examples. Apply to the Nov 20 semiconductor selloff and Keysight's Nov 19 reported $2.339B orders; do not equate price weakness with an operating breakdown. https://investor.keysight.com/investor-news-and-events/financial-press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Keysight-Technologies-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-Year-2026-Results/default.aspx

cards.title: Bear markets create opportunities—and traps
cards.question: What distinguishes a discount from a value trap?
cards.selfCheck: Prioritize financially sound companies with durable products and credible technology roadmaps; lower price alone is not enough.
cards.prompt: Explain the investing lesson 'Bear markets create opportunities—and traps', with a practical example, limits and what evidence would falsify it. Use Keysight's Nov 19 $465M quarterly FCF and 37% CSG margin as evidence, but test organic orders and valuation before calling a drawdown an opportunity. https://investor.keysight.com/investor-news-and-events/financial-press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Keysight-Technologies-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-Year-2026-Results/default.aspx
